title: feat(scenarios): --lang zh|en and --prompt short|detailed choose the prompts the agent is given
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao2uXXmCjR4kVHvAji5B8xgV)_

epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw5wFsyVj9j5sxb8pj

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the CLI flags `--lang zh|en` and `--prompt short|detailed` on `objectstack-scenarios run` / `run-scenarios` (`cli.ts`, reached through the bin, not an export entry); through `./runner`: the new exports `PROMPT_LANGS`, `PromptLang`, `PROMPT_LENGTHS`, `PromptLength`, `PromptChoice`, `MissingLanguageError`, `promptLanguageGaps`, `promptLanguageRefusal`, `statedPromptChoice`, `promptChoiceText` (`prompts.ts`) and `samePromptChoice` (`driver.ts`); a new optional trailing `choice` parameter on `buildPrompt`, `iteratePrompt`, `templateIteratePrompt`, `questionPrompt`, `operationPrompt` (`prompts.ts`), `runHalf` (`orchestrate.ts`) and the `RecordingDriver` constructor (`driver.ts`); the new method `RecordedDriver.assertPromptChoice` (`driver.ts`); the new optional fields `RunOptions.promptChoice`, `CardRun.promptChoice` (`orchestrate.ts`), `Recording.promptChoice` (`driver.ts`) and `CardScorecard.promptChoice` (`scorecard.ts`). No export entry moves.
Metadata-protocol: none

Fixes #33743

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:跑分器新增 `--lang zh|en` 与 `--prompt short|detailed`。`--lang` 让卡片里写给模型的所有文字(搭建提示、迭代变更、每个问数和操作的提问)只用指定语言发出,三种模式和 `--ask-repeats` 的每一问都生效;`--prompt` 选择搭建这一轮用卡片的短提示还是详细提示。跑分器自己的外围说明保持英文。
- 为什么改:此前卡片文字一律按「有英文用英文」发出,搭建只用详细提示,评测只量了最有利的输入;客户会用中文、用一句话提需求,M3 给对照卡加中文提示也依赖这个开关。
- 风险与回滚:两个开关都不给时,9 张卡全部提示与 main 逐字节相同(880,752 字节,sha256 一致),记录、评分表、录制文件都不出现新字段。缺语言的卡在第一张卡开跑前就被跳过并列出缺的字段,不会悄悄换语言;回放的语言或提示与录制时不同,开跑前拒绝。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/prompts.ts` 的 `text` / `promptLanguageGaps`(语言选择与缺字段判定),`src/runner/cli.ts` 的开跑前跳过,`src/runner/driver.ts` 的 `assertPromptChoice`(回放拒绝)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts -t 33743`,预期 10 个用例全过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The choice** (`runner/prompts.ts`): `PromptChoice { lang?, prompt? }`. Every card text a prompt renders goes through one `text(t, choice, field)`. With no `lang` it renders `en ?? zh` as before. With a `lang` it renders that language and no other, and a missing text throws `MissingLanguageError` naming the field. `buildPrompt` takes `prompt.short` or `prompt.detailed` by `choice.prompt` (default `detailed`). `iteratePrompt`, `templateIteratePrompt`, `questionPrompt` and `operationPrompt` take the same choice. The iterate prompt always renders `iterate.change`, so `--prompt` changes the build turn only.
- **What the language covers** (design point 1): `prompt.short` / `prompt.detailed`, `iterate.change`, and each question's and each operation's `ask`. These are the four `LocalizedText` fields a prompt renders. The runner's own text stays in English: the preamble, the data contract, the naming rule and the answer instructions. So do the card's plain strings it quotes, a persona's `role` and an action's `summary`, which the schema does not localise. The README says so.
- **No silent fallback** (design point 2): `promptLanguageGaps(card, choice, modes)` lists every text the run's modes would render that the card lacks in the chosen language. Scratch needs the build prompt `--prompt` names, the iterate change, every question and every operation. Template needs all but the build prompt. Ask needs the questions and operations. The CLI runs this check **before the first card**, before the workspace packages are built and before any scaffold or boot. It prints `skipped CARD: --lang zh sends every card text in zh and no other language, and this card has no zh text for …`, listing each field, and runs the other cards. With none left it exits 2. `runCard` throws the same text for a library caller before any mode runs.
- **Defaults** (design point 3): with neither flag, every prompt, record, scorecard and recording is unchanged byte for byte. The choice is written only when a flag is given (`statedPromptChoice`).
- **Record and scorecard** (design point 4): `CardRun.promptChoice` and `CardScorecard.promptChoice` carry only the flags given. Both reach the run record (`cardRun`, `scorecard`). `renderScorecard` prints `prompts: language zh · build prompt short` under the packages line, with an unchosen half shown as its default.
- **Replay** (design point 5): the recording carries the choice (`Recording.promptChoice`, written by `RecordingDriver` only when a flag is given). `RecordedDriver.assertPromptChoice` refuses a different choice before any card runs. The refusal names both choices and the flags to replay with. `--prompt detailed` is the default's own prompt, so it replays a recording made without flags. `--lang en` counts as a different choice from none and is refused, because on a Chinese-only text the two render differently.
- **Every mode** (design point 7): the choice is threaded through `RunOptions.promptChoice` to scratch (build, iterate, both Run halves), template (iterate, Run half) and ask (Run half). Each ask of a repeated question is included.
- **Docs**: a README usage line and a **Language and build prompt** entry. The changeset is a patch.

## Tests

`test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe` with 10 tests. `setup()` gains an optional `scenario`, so the fakes can run a variant of the crm card: a bilingual twin whose Chinese texts are the English ones with a marker in front.

- **Flags**: `parseArgs` for both flags, unknown values refused (`fr`, `zh-CN`, `long`), a missing value refused, and neither flag set when absent.
- **Defaults**: a run with no choice and a run with `{}` in all three modes send the same prompts under the same keys. They write the same record and render the same scorecard, with no `promptChoice` and no `prompts:` line. A recording made with no choice or `{}` carries no `promptChoice`. The build prompt carries `prompt.detailed.en` and a question carries its English ask. The `en ?? zh` fallback on a Chinese-only text is unchanged.
- **`--lang zh` in every mode with `--ask-repeats 2`**: the build turn is sent `prompt.detailed.zh`, and both iterates (scratch and template) are sent `iterate.change.zh`. Four Run halves each send 9 × 2 question asks plus 5 operations, each starting with its Chinese ask. No English card text appears as a prompt's text. The record and scorecard state `{ lang: 'zh' }`.
- **`--prompt short`**: the build turn equals the default with `prompt.detailed` swapped for `prompt.short`. Every other prompt is byte-identical to the default. The scorecard states it.
- **Four combinations**: `buildPrompt` renders `short`/`detailed` × `zh`/`en` to the card's own text. `--lang en` equals the default on a card with English.
- **Refusal**: per-mode gaps on the English-only crm card. Only the build prompt that is sent counts. `runCard` rejects with every field named, before any scaffold or prompt. A prompt asked to render a missing text throws `MissingLanguageError`.
- **CLI skip**: `main(--only crm --lang zh)` prints the skip line and `no card to run…`, returns 2, writes nothing to `--out` or `--work`, and never opens the replay file.
- **Replay**: a recording made under `{ lang: 'zh', prompt: 'short' }` carries it in the saved file. The same choice replays. No choice or a partial choice is refused with the flags to use. A default recording accepts no flag and `--prompt detailed`, and refuses `--lang en`. Through `main` it is refused before any card runs.
- **Chinese grading** (design point 6, `score/**` untouched): on `leave_balances`, the Chinese reply `你有 1 个待审批的步骤…来源：approval_step` for `pending_by_approver` as `employee` grades `correct`, `cited`, with no leaks. So does a spaceless `你有1个…` cited with `Source:`. A wrong Chinese figure is not correct. An all-rows question (`annual_days_by_department`) answered in Chinese is correct and cited. On the unanswerable `unpaid_leave_deduction`, a Chinese decline (`无法回答：…没有记录工资`) passes and an invented Chinese figure fails.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's "Done when", in order:
  - `--lang zh|en` picks the language of every prompt (build, iterate, question, operation), with no silent fallback. A card missing a field is reported and not run.
  - `--prompt short|detailed` picks the build turn's prompt, default `detailed`, unchanged.
  - The scorecard and run record state both choices.
  - Tests pin the rendered prompt for each combination on one card, and the refusal.
- Design point 6 was checked before anything else was built on it. The grader already reads `来源：`, Chinese measure words, `万`/`亿`, and Chinese declines (`无法`, `未记录`, `没有记录`). No change to `score/**` was needed.
- Three control cards (`crm_account_with_contacts`, `invoice_with_line_items`, `project_with_tasks`) have no Chinese text today, so `--lang zh` skips them by name. M3's "control cards gain Chinese prompts" row is what fills them. The other six cards carry both languages in every field.
- Off-limits paths are untouched: `src/score/**`, `src/schema.ts`, the card JSONs and `src/export/**`. The cloud#3600 cost ruling and Ruling A on #31999 item 9 are unaffected, because no scoring code changed. `packages/spec` is untouched.
- The skip is reported on stderr before the first card, not written as a run record. A card that is not run has no halves to record, and the multi-run summary is M3's row.

## Verification

<details><summary>Default parity against main</summary>

- Every prompt for every card of the open library (9 cards; build, iterate, template iterate, every question, every operation), rendered by `main`'s `prompts.ts` (`2539ad98`) and by this branch with no choice, with `{}` and with `{ prompt: 'detailed' }`, under `tsx`: 880,752 bytes, sha256 prefix `b3357be8d7eaa6fb` for all four, `identical true`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

- `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head. The tests import `src`, so there is no build leg. Each mutation was restored with `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob equal to HEAD.
  - `runCard` without its language refusal: 1 failed / 9 passed (the no-silent-fallback test).
  - `text()` ignoring `lang` (always `en ?? zh`): 3 failed / 7 passed (every mode in zh, the four combinations, the refusal).
  - `assertPromptChoice` always accepting: 1 failed / 9 passed (the replay test).
</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build` :: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` :: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test` :: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0): 34 test files passed (34), 922 tests passed (922), on `78f7e31e`. A first run without the package's own `dist/` failed only the two `test/build/*` files on their prerequisite ("build @objectstack/scenarios first"). After the build, all 34 passed.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the six touched TS files :: exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `78f7e31e`, 8 paths, 66 families), each run with stdin from `/dev/null`: 64 exit 0, and 2 exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET):
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` could not read its pinned fixture commit in the shallow clone. After `git fetch origin 621a4876…`, a rerun exited 0 ("48 cases pass"). The rerun is recorded on its own line. The first-run record is kept as it was.
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is NOT MEASURED locally, because it needs every package's `dist/`. CI runs it.
  - `--ran` on the first-run record: "66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- Main (`bf594ebd`) was merged once before opening (`78f7e31e`). It touched only `ui/` app-shell, so nothing was rebuilt for it.
- 582 changed lines (+547/-35) in 8 files. No governed surface, and `packages/spec` is untouched.
</details>
